verdict.rationale: Qodo documents configuration-as-code through a .pr_agent.toml file that can live at the repository level. That makes a versioned in-repo config file a first-party capability, though the docs call the portal the recommended path. Nothing in the evidence shows path filters, per-path instructions, or review profiles in that file; the Minimal/Standard/Comprehensive presets are described only as Display options, not file-based review profiles. Missing for 10: documented path filters, per-path instructions, review profiles in the config file, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering lead, I configure the reviewer with a versioned config file in my repo — path filters, per-path instructions, review profiles

citations.quote: Manage Qodo configuration as code using a .pr_agent.toml file at the repository, project, group, or organization level.
Choose a ready-made preset, Minimal, Standard, Comprehensive, or Custom, instead of setting each Display option individually.
